title: Without Invoicing View, work order and part sale invoices are plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access", "Work Orders → View", "Part Sales → View" but not "Invoicing & Payments → View".
  • Have a customer with an overdue work order invoice A and an overdue part sale invoice B, both made at your current location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with that customer's group expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Look at invoice A's and invoice B's numbers.
  2. Click invoice A's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both are plain text.

Step 2:

  • Nothing opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-N2: “A document the user lacks the permission for shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R1: “A document number is a link only when the user has the permission to open it and can open it in its own location; otherwise it shows as plain text.”
  • Story 7 Prerequisites: “An invoice or part sale opens for a user with 'Invoicing & Payments → View' and 'Work Orders → View' (work orders) or 'Part Sales → View' (part sales).”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.
